name: Data for "Simulating interactions between cytoskeletal filaments"
description: This dataset contains the data and the parameter files used for producing the figures in the article named "Simulating interactions between cytoskeletal filaments" by Pajanonot et al. The contents of this folder are folders containing the data and parameter files used for each of the figures and subfigures of the article. These data have been produced by Sophia Hampe and Kristian Pajanonot. A customised currently unpublished version of cytosim have been used to produce these data. If you have any questions about the data please contact Stefan Klumpp stefam.klumpp@phys.uni-goettingen.de.

citation.name: K. Pajanonot, S. Hampe, K. Bhattacharyya, P. Kumari, S. Köster, S. Klumpp, Simulating interactions between cytoskeletal filaments, Eur. Phys. J. Special Topics

distribution.name: Fig1A.zip
distribution.description: This folder contains the cytosim configuration file used to produce the image files presented in Figure 1 A. This folder contains an example set of images showing the whole simulation and a video of the whole simulation. Part of which is presented in Figure 1A.

distribution.name: Fig1B.zip
distribution.description: This folder contains the data presented in Figure 1 B. For unbinding rate 0.11 /s and unbinding force 25 pN is saved in the folder named "unbinding_rate_0p01_unbinding_force_25". The measured force on the filament by the interaction over time for 1 examplary iteration shown in Figure 1B is saved in the file ForceOverTime_Trajectory.txt. The pre-processed data with force over time for every of the 100 independent trial is saved in files named combined_midforce_abs.txt. And the cytosim configuration files which can be run using the software cytosim are named config.cym.

distribution.name: Fig2A.zip
distribution.description: This folder contains data presented in Figure 2 A and, the list of breaking forces, saved in BreakingForce.txt. And the pre-processed data used of the quantification: force over time for every of the 100 independent trial is saved in combined_midforce_abs.txt, for unbinding rate 0.11 /s and unbinding force 25 pN. We also include the cytosim configuration files which can be run using cytosim.

distribution.name: Fig2B.zip
distribution.description: This folder contains the data presented in Figure 2 B. For unbinding rates 0.01/s , 0.11 /s and 0.16 /s and unbinding force 16 pN, 25 pN and 35 pN. Each of the subfolders within the folder contains data for each combination of parameters showed in Figure 2 B. The naming conventions of the folders are following the parameters. As an example the data for the parameters unbinding rate 0.01/s and unbinding force 25 pN is saved in the folder named "unbinding_rate_0p01_unbinding_force_25". The list of breaking forces is saved in files named BreakingForce.txt. The pre-processed data used of the quantification: force over time for every of the 100 independent trial is saved in files named combined_midforce_abs.txt. And the cytosim configuration files which can be run using the software cytosim are named config.cym.

distribution.name: Fig3A_B.zip
distribution.description: This folder contains data presented in Figure 3 A and B. The force w.r.t time is saved in ForceOverTime.txt plotted in Figure 3 A and the list of breaking forces is saved in BreakingForce.txt plotted in Figure 3 B. As well as the preprocessed data of measured force on the interaction over time for the 100 independent trial is saved in combined_midforce_abs.txt. the configuration files used to generate the data from cytosim is config.cym. All these above data for 1 bond is saved in Linker1, for 2 bonds is saved in Linker2 and 5 bonds is saved in Linker5.

publications.citation: K. Pajanonot, S. Hampe, K. Bhattacharyya, P. Kumari, S. Köster, S. Klumpp, Simulating interactions between cytoskeletal filaments, Eur. Phys. J. Special Topics
